card.name: Words before an award or post obtained
card.fires_on: Small words such as a, his, first or awarded right after a verb of getting an honor, scholarship or position (awarded, earned, obtained, secure) in biographies.

modes.label: Winning an award
modes.description: Word just after was awarded, win or earned, before a prize or scholarship.
modes.example: In 1932, four years after returning to the United States, he was awarded with his<< first>> Pulitzer Prize for a poem titled Conquist

modes.label: Obtaining a post
modes.description: Article after obtained or secure, before an appointment or office.
modes.example: he obtained<< a>> public office at Martinique

card.plain: It lights up in biographies on the word right after someone is given a prize, scholarship or job.
